descriptions.w3d_d28b_launch_effect_8009aaac: Launch effect setup: reads ActiveWormIndex and the worm, posts the launch message, reads Weapon.GraphicalLaunchLocation, and when the target object at +36 exists uses its position or, for the default vector, a point 1000 units ahead along the worm pitch and yaw (0x801a3eb0), then sets the emitter +32 position, scale (z is a hundredth of the distance) and rotation from 0x8009b070; returns 0.
